in_arabic.name: Bikr
in_arabic.long_meaning: Bikr هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'b-k-r', meaning 'to be alive, to be awake, or to be alert'. This name is mentioned in the Quran and is associated with Prophet Ibrahim's servant, al-Khidr. It signifies a person who is full of energy, life, and consciousness, always alert and responsive to the will of God.
